title: Real export/restore: inclusion gate, authenticated encryption, reference verification (VC-201-070)
goal: VC-201-070 refuted: backup() has no explicit-inclusion gate — a `keys` section exports identically to config; 'encryption' is single-byte XOR (the field comment says 'test-grade'): any wrong key restores garbage with no error (no authentication), and one known plaintext byte recovers the key; collect_sections silently drops missing files instead of reporting unavailable resources; restore verifies no references — dangling artifact refs restore fine; library-only, no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_070_mastery.rs.
